context_requirements: Expression of the drug's ATP-sensitive potassium channel target (e.g., KCNJ11/ABCC8, KCNJ8, KCNJ10) in the cell line
Functional coupling of the channel to a transcriptional signaling pathway
A cell context where channel activity is rate-limiting for a transcriptional program
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Changes in genes known to be downstream of ATP-sensitive potassium channels (e.g., insulin secretion, calcium signaling) in responsive lines
